_comment: IRAF 2.18.1 apall with references='A', after apall on A as in iraf_apall.json's d2_none (interactive=no, find, resize, trace, extract, nfind=2, format multispec). A is tests/iraf_field.spectra_frame(), B spectra_frame(1.3), arc arc_frame(), all with DISPAXIS=2; every other parameter IRAF's default unless in 'params' (harwood's names). 'log' is the RECENTER line apextract.logfile got; 'apertures' what IRAF wrote to database/ap<image> (center, low, high along the slit); the bands are in iraf_apall_references.npz as <case>__<band>.

r_shift.log: RECENTER  - 2 apertures shifted by 1.18 for B.

r_peak.log: RECENTER  - 2 apertures shifted by 0.46 for B.

r_aprec.log: RECENTER  - 2 apertures shifted by 1.91 for B.

r_full.log: RECENTER  - 2 apertures shifted by 1.18 for B.
